correctness.rationale: Over algebraic closure of F5, nonzero coordinate derivatives reduce to z_i²−2Tz_i+3P=0 for z_i=x_i⁴. If support size r≤3, they force r=3 and a common nonzero fourth power (64 points). If r=4, distinct quadratic roots yield a contradiction with P²=∏z_i, so all four z_i coincide and P=−a² (32 points). Euler 8F=Σx_i∂F forces critical points onto the octic. Two explicit affine Hessians have determinant 3 mod 5; symmetry carries ordinary-node status to all 96. All 156 F5 projective points are independently enumerated, with exactly the 96 singular points on the surface. Isolated singularities imply geometric integrality and normality by hypersurface S2+R1. The finite census alone would not prove geometric completeness.
